title: Architect
description:
**About the Team**

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled **Backend Senior Software Engineer (Node.js / API)** to join the Digital Business Banking team. This team is responsible for building scalable, secure, and high-performance backend services supporting payments, onboarding, and money movement workflows.

As an Engineer, you will drive API strategy, and ensure delivery of robust, cloud-native microservices aligned with enterprise banking platforms.

**What You Will Be Doing**

**Technical Leadership & Architecture**

* Own the end-to-end backend design, and implementation of scalable API-driven systems.
* Lead development using **Node.js, TypeScript, and microservices architecture**.
* Define standards for **API design, service communication, data flow, event-driven patterns, and security**.
* Evaluate modern tools and technologies to enhance system scalability, resilience, and observability.

**Core Engineering & Delivery**

* Design and build **RESTful APIs, backend services, and event-driven applications**.
* Develop and maintain **microservices hosted on AWS (Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, SQS/SNS)**.
* Ensure high performance, scalability, and fault tolerance across distributed systems.
* Guide implementation of **API Gateway (Kong preferred), service mesh, and integration frameworks**.

**Problem Solving & Technical Ownership**

* Translate business and domain requirements into scalable backend solutions.
* Troubleshoot complex issues across services, integrations, and cloud environments.
* Optimize application performance, latency, memory usage, and data processing efficiency.

**Quality, Testing & Governance**

* Implement strong backend testing practices including **unit, integration, and contract testing**.
* Drive code quality using **static code analysis, security scanning (DevSecOps), and best practices**.
* Introduce governance for **observability, logging, monitoring, and CI/CD automation**.

**Collaboration & Mentoring**

* Work with Product, Frontend, QA, Cloud, Security, and Architecture teams.
* Mentor developers and drive adoption of backend best practices and standards.
* Lead design discussions, API reviews, and technical roadmap planning.

**What You Bring**

* 7–10+ years of backend development experience with leadership responsibilities.
* Strong expertise in **Node.js, TypeScript, Express/NestJS frameworks**.
* Deep knowledge of **REST APIs, microservices architecture, and integration patterns**.
* Experience with **AWS cloud services (Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, SQS/SNS, DynamoDB, RDS)**.
* Strong database experience with **SQL (Oracle/SQL Server) and distributed data systems**.
* Experience with **event-driven architecture and messaging systems (Kafka/SNS/SQS)**.
* Hands-on experience with **CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and DevOps practices**.
* Familiarity with **API Gateway (Kong preferred) and API lifecycle management**.
* Exposure to **security best practices and DevSecOps workflows**.
* Strong problem-solving, debugging, and analytical capabilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Nice to Have****:** Exposure to AI/LLM integrations, real-time processing

**What We Offer You**

* Leadership role in building critical backend systems for digital banking platforms.
* Opportunity to design large-scale distributed systems in a FinTech environment.
* Collaborative and innovation-driven culture.
* Access to continuous learning and career growth opportunities.

title: Software Engineering Lead
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

As a Sr. Software Engineer I on our engineering team, you will design, develop, and deliver high-performing full-stack applications with a major focus on advanced React front-end architecture and AI/ML solution integration. In this role, you will spearhead the creation of rich, responsive, component-driven user interfaces using React while building robust backend microservices in Java and optimizing relational database applications with PL/SQL. Additionally, you will play a key role in architecting and deploying AI/ML capabilities, predictive models, and intelligent workflows into enterprise healthcare software to drive data-driven decision-making and automated user experiences.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Architect, build, and maintain responsive, high-performance web interfaces using React.js, modern JavaScript/TypeScript, and component-driven front-end design patterns
* Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML-powered solutions and intelligent capabilities to address complex business challenges with an emphasis on responsible use of AI
* Integrate AI/ML models, machine learning APIs, and generative AI features into full-stack Java and React applications to power automated workflows
* Use enterprise-approved AI tools and ML platforms to streamline software development workflows, automate tasks, and drive continuous improvement
* Evaluate emerging trends in AI/ML engineering and modern React front-end frameworks to inform architecture design and strategic innovation
* Write, optimize, and maintain high-performance database queries, stored procedures, and triggers using PL/SQL to support AI/ML data models and web applications
* Build and maintain robust RESTful APIs and microservices using Java to seamlessly connect React front-ends with AI/ML services and relational database layers
* Conduct code reviews, implement unit/integration testing, and enforce software engineering and AI/ML safety and quality standards
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of professional software engineering experience working in a full-stack capacity
* 4+ years of hands-on experience designing and building modern front-end user interfaces using React.js (including state management, Hooks, and component architecture)
* 4+ years of backend software engineering experience using Java and enterprise frameworks (e.g., Spring / Spring Boot)
* 4+ years of experience working with relational databases and writing complex PL/SQL queries, stored procedures, and database optimizations
* 3+ years of experience designing, building, and consuming RESTful APIs and microservices to support React web applications and AI/ML integrations
* 3+ years of experience working within an Agile/Scrum development team
* 3+ years of experience integrating AI/ML models, machine learning APIs, or intelligent automation services into software applications

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with AI/ML frameworks, model deployment platforms, Large Language Models (LLMs), or MLOps practices
* Experience with advanced React state management libraries (e.g., Redux, Context API) and modern web build tools (e.g., Webpack, Vite)
* Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization/orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
* Experience in the healthcare technology domain or working with health data standards
* Familiarity with CI/CD deployment pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions)

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: AI & LLM Engineer
description:
The AI & LLM Engineer will drive the strategy, design, and deployment of advanced Artificial Intelligence and Large Language Model (LLM) solutions to transform engineering, operational processes, and project execution. This role ensures secure, scalable, and compliant AI adoption within power automation workflows, enabling productivity gains, continuous learning, and long-term competitiveness in the utility sector.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

  
  

* Lead AI/LLM strategy, solution architecture, and implementation across Engineering, Operations, and Project Delivery.
* Build and maintain LLM-based agents to support:
  + intelligent processing of technical documentation,
  + automated design validation and engineering workflows,
  + testing and QA automation,
  + knowledge retrieval and contextual reasoning.
* Integrate AI into core power automation workflows:
  + IEC 61850 SCD engineering files, relay settings, SCADA HMI & logic, substation documentation, etc.
* Establish AI governance, secure data pipelines, and compliance with utility-grade cybersecurity standards.
* Partner with engineering managers and subject-matter experts to identify high-value AI automation opportunities.
* Develop scalable pipelines for inference, fine-tuning, continuous learning, and lifecycle management in cloud and on-prem environments.
* Evaluate and incorporate emerging AI technologies (RAG, vector stores, autonomous agents, internal copilots).
* Monitor model performance, accuracy, drift, and cost; lead improvement cycles and risk mitigation.
* Train and coach engineering teams on practical AI tools and adoption in daily workflows.
* Ensure compliance with GE Vernova global standards, regulatory expectations, and utility-sector requirements.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**

  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field.

* Professional Experience
  + Hands-on experience with AI/ML development and production deployment.
  + Proven track record in full product lifecycle: ideation, prototyping, development, operations.
  + Industrial, energy, or automation domain experience strongly preferred.

  

**Desired Characteristics**

  
  

Deep expertise with:

* Large Language Models, generative AI, and intelligent agents
* Engineering workflow automation
* Python and modern ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow)
* API-driven solution design and MLOps practices
* Cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP) and on-prem architectures
* Data governance and cybersecurity best practices

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

title: Sr Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized around the world. Adobe is listed as Fortune’s “100 Best Companies to Work For” for 20 consecutive years. You will also be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to helping each other grow. If you’re looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you. Discover what our employees are saying about their career experiences on the Adobe Life blog and explore the meaningful benefits we offer.
  
  
Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give global brands everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We’re passionate about transforming how companies interact with customers across every screen.
  
The Opportunity
  
Adobe Experience Platform and Apps powers real-time customer experiences for the world’s largest enterprises — unifying data, resolving identity at scale, orchestrating journeys, and activating audiences across channels.
  
  
The Forward Deployed Engineer sits at the intersection of solution architecture, technical consulting, and hands-on engineering. You’ll work directly with Adobe’s strategic customers to solve complex platform challenges, design scalable architectures, and build solutions that accelerate adoption.
  
You’ll operate in a multi-functional Customer Pod with end-to-end ownership, partnering with customers, product teams, and engineers to turn complex problems into working solutions.
  
What You’ll Do
  
Partner with strategic customers to understand their architecture, workflows, security requirements, and business objectives.
  
Translate complex customer problems into scalable solution designs, reference architectures, and working prototypes.
  
Investigate and resolve production-level platform issues across data ingestion, identity resolution, journey orchestration, and audience activation.
  
Design and validate enterprise solutions spanning AEP, AJO, Marketo, and adjacent Adobe systems.
  
Lead architecture workshops, health checks, and technical deep-dives that build customer trust.
  
Prototype, experiment, and iterate rapidly, using AI-assisted tools as part of your everyday workflow.
  
Connect customer needs with product and engineering teams, bringing field insights back into the product roadmap.
  
Own the technical relationship with assigned accounts from discovery through implementation, launch, and expansion.
  
What Success Looks Like
  
We hire for demonstrated impact and experience. You’ll bring a combination of technical depth, customer empathy, and collaborative problem solving.
  
**Hands-on engineering:** You write code, build prototypes, and ship working software. Your architecture decisions are grounded in implementation experience.
  
**Customer empathy:** You understand customers’ goals, constraints, and definitions of success and build trusted relationships through empathy and technical expertise.
  
**Collaboration and communication:** You work effectively with engineers, architects, product managers, and leaders and communicate complex concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  
**Enterprise architecture:** You design end-to-end solutions across products and systems, considering integration, scale, security, and production requirements.
  
**Data expertise:** You understand how data is structured, modeled, and moved and can evaluate trade-offs in schema design, identity resolution, and data pipelines.
  
**AI fluency and continuous learning:** You embrace AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent to design, prototype, and deliver solutions.
  
**Proactive problem solving:** You identify emerging challenges and take initiative to move them toward resolution.
  
What You Need to Succeed
  
10+ years of experience across solution architecture, software engineering, technical consulting, or customer-facing engineering.
  
Bachelor’s or advanced degree in computer science or a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
Experience with CDP, MDM, martech, or data platforms.
  
Experience with data governance, privacy-preserving computation, or secure data collaboration.
  
Familiarity with identity resolution or customer data unification.
  
Experience with workflow orchestration technologies such as Temporal, Step Functions, or similar.
  
Experience contributing to architecture decisions or technical strategy at the team or organizational level.
  
Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud products such as AEP, AJO, Marketo, CJA, or Target is helpful.
  
Experience working in regulated industries such as Financial Services, Healthcare, or Government is also helpful.
  
Why This Team
  
You’ll solve complex enterprise problems with direct customer impact and see your solutions reach production. You’ll combine architecture, engineering, strategy, and customer engagement while working with experienced engineers across Adobe’s global platform teams.
  
You’ll also help shape an engineering engagement model centered on rapid experimentation, customer feedback, and AI-assisted execution.
  
  
Come build the next generation of enterprise customer experiences with us!
  
  
Adobe is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and encourage diversity in the workplace regardless of race, gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or veteran status.
  
About Adobe
  
Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
  
  
Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.
  
  
Let’s Adobe together
  
At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture , focus on people, purpose and community , Adobe for All , comprehensive benefits programs , the stories we tell , the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.
  
  
Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.
  
  
Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com .
  
  
**AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:**  
Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.

title: Senior Data Engineering Analyst
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Data Engineering & Pipeline Development
  + Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes supporting batch and streaming workloads
  + Build and optimize data ingestion frameworks using technologies such as Apache Spark, Kafka, and cloud-native services

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, Engineering, or a related field
* 4+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering, or related areas
* Solid experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines and large-scale data processing systems
* Hands-on experience with Apache Spark and distributed data processing frameworks
* Experience working with Kafka or other streaming technologies
* Experience with Snowflake, Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, or similar cloud data platforms
* Solid knowledge of data warehousing and lakehouse architectures
* Solid understanding of data governance, metadata management, and data lineage concepts
* Familiarity with CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and DevOps practices
* Proficiency in SQL and Python
* Proven excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
* Proven solid communication and stakeholder management capabilities

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Hands-on experience with AWS services such as S3, Glue, EMR, Lambda, Redshift, IAM, KMS, and CloudWatch
* Experience implementing HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC2, or other regulated industry compliance requirements
* Experience supporting AI, Machine Learning, and Data Science workloads
* Experience with Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker, and modern cloud-native architectures
* Knowledge of data security practices including encryption, tokenization, data masking, and access management
* Familiarity with feature stores, MLOps, and ML data pipelines
* Proven exposure to vulnerability management tools such as Snyk, Wiz, Trivy, or equivalent

title: Sr Engineer - Process Engineering
description:
The Senior Engineer – Process Engineering is responsible for independently executing and owning assigned process engineering and customer application engineering scope for boiler and thermal power plant service, retrofit, renovation and modernization (R&M), and new product introduction (NPI) programs. The role is expected to develop technically compliant, competitive, and customer-focused engineering solutions across inquiry-to-order (ITO), execution, and product implementation phases within assigned scope.
  
The position requires strong technical knowledge in boiler performance, thermal system analysis, steam-water cycle integration, and process engineering deliverables, along with the ability to develop and review technical inputs for bids, proposals, technical clarifications, and risk assessments. The role works closely with global engineering teams, regional stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to ensure high-quality engineering output aligned with business objectives, customer requirements, and GE Vernova standards for safety, quality, delivery, and cost.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Independently execute and own assigned process engineering scope related to boiler performance, thermal system analysis, and steam-water cycle integration for service, retrofit, renovation and modernization (R&M), and new product introduction (NPI) programs.

* Prepare and review engineering deliverables such as process calculations, process flow diagrams, P&IDs, process descriptions, operating philosophies, performance evaluations, and related technical documentation.

* Analyze customer enquiries, tender documents, operating data, and technical specifications to define technically compliant, competitive, and executable application engineering solutions within assigned scope.

* Develop and Review customer application engineering activities, including preparation of technical inputs for bids and proposals, compliance matrices, customer submittals, process schemes, technical deviations, assumptions, scope clarifications, and feasibility evaluations.

* Lead technical discussions with customers and internal stakeholders to explain proposed solutions, engineering assumptions, and application feasibility.

* Contribute to opportunity assessment for boiler upgrade and retrofit packages, including emissions-related modifications and performance improvement solutions.

* Coordinate with commercial, sourcing, execution, controls and instrumentation, mechanical, and project engineering teams to develop optimized technical solutions and ensure alignment of scope, assumptions, interfaces, and deliverables.

* Identify, assess, document, and support mitigation of technical deviations, assumptions, risks, and opportunities during application engineering, project execution, and product implementation phases.

* Work closely with global engineering teams, regional stakeholders, and subject matter experts to align technical solutions with customer requirements, fleet needs, business objectives, and implementation constraints.

* Drive technical risk assessment reviews with global teams and subject matter experts to identify design, performance, operability, reliability, maintainability, and execution risks associated with proposed boiler solutions.

* Take ownership of assigned ITO activities through project handover.

* Ensure high-quality and consistent engineering output related to performance calculations, thermal assessments, design reviews, optimization studies, and technical evaluations.

* Support NPI activities through evaluation of new or modified process concepts, product features, design changes, engineering validation requirements, and implementation considerations.

* Contribute to technical excellence through participation in design reviews, technical reviews, constructability reviews, lessons learned implementation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

* Provide technical guidance and review support to less experienced engineers and contribute to knowledge sharing and capability building across the team.

* Ensure engineering deliverables are completed in accordance with applicable standards, customer requirements, product requirements, and business processes, while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality, delivery, and cost (SQDC).

* Contribute to functional initiatives and metrics related to Life Saving Rules, Product Safety embedded in design, On-Time Delivery, Right First Time, Kaizen, productivity, cost-out, quality, and Lean Six Sigma.

  

**Qualifications / Essential Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, or equivalent from an accredited university or college.

* Relevant experience in boiler engineering, process engineering, thermal engineering, performance engineering, or steam power plant applications.

* Relevant experience in process engineering for service, retrofit, renovation and modernization (R&M), customer application engineering, or related thermal power projects.

* Strong technical knowledge of boiler performance, thermodynamics, heat and mass balance, combustion-related process considerations, and steam power plant systems.

* Experience preparing and reviewing process engineering deliverables and technical documentation for boiler or thermal power applications.

* Familiarity with engineering tools, methods, and systems relevant to process engineering, performance evaluation, and power plant applications.

* Demonstrated ability to define engineering assumptions and support resolution of technical issues within assigned scope.

* Demonstrated ability to identify, assess, and manage technical risks within assigned scope with appropriate urgency and discipline.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical information clearly to internal and external stakeholders.

* Ability to work to committed timelines while maintaining safety, quality, and engineering integrity.

* Willingness to travel to sites and flexibility to support business requirements, as needed.

**Desired Characteristics**

* Strong analytical and technical problem-solving skills.

* Demonstrated ability to develop practical, technically sound, and customer-focused engineering solutions.

* Experience supporting customer application engineering, technical proposals, or tendering activities.

* Familiarity with NPI, product change management, validation support, or technology implementation in an engineering environment.

* Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work across functions, regions, and engineering disciplines.

* Familiarity with Lean, continuous improvement, and standardization practices.

* Customer-focused mindset with balanced attention to technical, commercial, and execution priorities.

* Ability to influence through technical depth, clear communication, and disciplined execution.

* Experience using digital engineering tools, structured documentation systems, and productivity tools in a global engineering environment.

* Awareness of AI-enabled tools for engineering productivity, document quality improvement, technical knowledge retrieval, and data analysis, with appropriate engineering validation.

* Note:
    
  **To comply with US immigration and other legal requirements, it is necessary to specify the minimum number of years’ experience required for any role based within the USA.** **For roles outside of the USA, to ensure compliance with applicable legislation, the JDs should focus on the substantive level of experience required for the role and a minimum number of years should NOT be used.**

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

title: AI Engineer
description:

In this role, you will drive the development of cutting-edge AI models and solutions—from statistical modeling and predictive analytics to advanced generative and agentic applications.

* Design and develop AI-powered systems using both traditional ML and Generative AI techniques, including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, embeddings, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures

* 4 to 6 years of hands-on experience in AI/ML development or intelligent application engineering
* Strong proficiency in Python and familiarity with modern ML/AI libraries (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenAI APIs)

* Experience with MLOps pipelines, CI/CD for model delivery, RAG evaluation frameworks (e.g., RAGAS), or model monitoring is a plus
* Knowledge of AI system evaluation, observability, prompt performance testing, and grounding validation is a plus
* Ability to work on cross-functional teams, balance multiple projects, and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences

title: Senior Computer Scientist - C++
description:
The Opportunity
  
Adobe builds products that power millions of customer experiences worldwide. Behind these products are sophisticated software systems operating at scale, where performance, reliability, security, and engineering excellence are fundamental requirements.
  
We are looking for a Senior Computer Scientist with deep C\+\+ expertise who enjoys solving complex technical problems and taking ownership of significant areas of the product. You will shape architecture, build high\-performance software, make critical technical decisions, and influence solutions that span components and teams.
  
We value engineers who are self\-driven, proactive, and outcome\-oriented — engineers who challenge assumptions, solve problems at their root, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and take responsibility for making the systems they own better, more reliable, and easier to evolve.
  
  

What You'll Do
  
Own and evolve significant technical areas end\-to\-end — from understanding ambiguous problems and defining the right solution through architecture, implementation, production validation, and long\-term evolution.
  
Design and build high\-performance C\+\+ systems , making thoughtful decisions around architecture, concurrency, memory management, resource utilization, and scalability.
  
Drive technical direction for complex problems — evaluate alternatives, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and influence architecture decisions across components and teams.
  
Solve problems at the root — identify systemic causes rather than treating symptoms, and drive durable solutions that reduce recurring issues and technical debt.
  
Own outcomes, not just tasks — proactively identify gaps, risks, and opportunities and drive them to closure with minimal direction.
  
Solve complex problems across boundaries , collaborating with engineers, architects, product managers, and other teams to deliver cohesive solutions.
  
Raise the engineering bar through architecture and code reviews, performance optimization, testing, and engineering best practices.
  
Build for operational excellence with strong focus on performance, reliability, security, observability, maintainability, and efficient resource utilization.
  
Be a force multiplier — mentor engineers, share technical expertise, and establish patterns and practices that improve the broader engineering organization.
  
Leverage AI\-assisted engineering to accelerate development and problem solving, improve engineering workflows, and increase team productivity.
  
  

What You Need to Succeed
  
B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
10\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience , with a strong track record of owning and delivering complex technical solutions.
  
Deep expertise in C\+\+ , including modern C\+\+, memory management, concurrency, multithreading, STL, and performance optimization.
  
Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, object\-oriented design, operating systems, and computer science fundamentals .
  
Strong understanding of systems design, distributed systems, concurrency, scalability, and performance engineering .
  
Experience designing and building large\-scale, high\-performance software systems .
  
Experience building or operating Distributed systems at scale , with an understanding of multi\-tenancy, scaling, reliability, backward compatibility, security, observability, and capacity planning.
  
Strong experience with performance analysis and optimization , including profiling CPU, memory, I/O, latency, and resource utilization.
  
Experience with cloud platforms, distributed infrastructure, and modern software development practices.
  
Strong proficiency in AI\-assisted engineering , leveraging tools such as Claude, Codex, or Copilot to accelerate development, improve problem solving, and enhance engineering productivity.
  
Strong technical judgment and problem\-solving ability , with the ability to navigate ambiguity and influence technical decisions across teams.
  
  

What Success Looks Like
  
Success in this role is not measured only by the features you deliver. You will be successful when you:
  
Own and evolve significant technical areas with minimal direction and strong technical judgment.
  
Turn ambiguous, complex problems into clear technical direction and executable solutions .
  
Make architecture decisions that balance performance, scalability, reliability, maintainability, and long\-term evolution .
  
Solve systemic problems at their root and eliminate recurring sources of complexity, performance issues, and operational risk.
  
Influence technical direction across teams and organizational boundaries through technical depth and credibility.
  
Deliver solutions that materially improve performance, scalability, reliability, quality, or developer productivity .
  
Raise the technical bar through mentorship, design leadership, and engineering practices that benefit the broader organization.
  
About Adobe
  
Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry\-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
  
  

Our 30,000\+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.
  
  

Let’s Adobe together
  
At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture , focus on people, purpose and community , Adobe for All , comprehensive benefits programs , the stories we tell , the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.
  
  

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.
  
  

Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com .
  
  

**AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:**  

Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.
  
  

At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI — and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it’s restricted during live interviews. See how we think about AI in the hiring experience .

title: R&D Engineering, Sr Engineer
description:
### **We Are**
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You are someone who looks at a test failure and does not just log it, you dig until you understand why it happened and what it means for the next release. Scripting is not a chore for you, it is how you make repetitive work disappear so you can focus on the problems that actually need a human brain. You have spent enough time in labs or codebases to know that quality is not something you test in at the end, it is something you build into the process from the start.


Data tells you stories. When you see a trend in regression results, you do not wait for someone else to notice, you pull the thread, ask the right questions, and surface what matters. You are comfortable working across teams, translating between what verification found, what design needs to know, and what a release checklist actually requires.


You do not need years of experience to have a point of view. You know when a process is not working and you are not afraid to suggest a better way. At Synopsys, you will work on Embedded Memory IP that powers the devices people use every day, and the rigor you bring to testing and automation will directly affect whether those products ship on time and work as promised.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Run kickoff and release meetings across design, verification, and release teams, making sure compliance checkpoints are hit and nothing falls through the cracks
* Execute regression testing on Embedded Memory IP, catch issues before they reach customers, and track results across release cycles
* Analyze test data to spot trends, recurring failures, and process gaps that affect product quality or schedule
* Write and maintain Python and Tcl automation scripts that eliminate manual testing steps and speed up validation workflows
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to align on quality gates, release criteria, and issue resolution timelines
* Document test results, failure analysis, and process improvements in a way that helps the next engineer understand what happened and why

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Ensure Embedded Memory IP on advanced process nodes ships with zero critical defects, directly affecting customer success and market readiness
* Reduce validation cycle time by automating repetitive test and data collection tasks, freeing engineers to focus on complex debug work
* Surface quality and process issues early in the development cycle, preventing costly delays and rework downstream
* Improve the reliability of regression infrastructure so teams can trust test results and make faster release decisions
* Strengthen compliance and traceability across the release process, reducing risk and audit friction
* Enable smarter decision\-making by turning raw test data into actionable insights for design and verification teams

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field
* 2 years of experience in validation, testing, quality assurance, or a related engineering role
* Working knowledge of Python or Tcl for scripting and automation
* Ability to analyze data, identify patterns, and communicate findings clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences
* Familiarity with regression testing, release processes, or quality management systems is a plus
* Strong problem\-solving instincts and the ability to work across teams without losing track of details

### **Who You Are**

* You can look at a spreadsheet of test results and spot the one anomaly that matters, not just the loudest failure
* You write scripts that other people can actually read and modify six months later
* You are comfortable running a meeting with senior engineers and keeping it focused without being intimidated
* When a process does not make sense, you ask why before you follow it blindly
* You can explain a technical issue to a release manager in two sentences without losing the nuance
* You stay organized when managing multiple release tracks, test cycles, and compliance checkpoints at once

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**


Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process.

### **Rewards and Benefits**


We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
